snippet.title: Fling Up Together - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gravity is shattered. Take a look at gameplay from Fling Up Together (formerly known as Fling Friends) in this trailer for the upcoming co-op physics platformer game. Fling Up Together will be available on PC, and a demo is coming to Steam this month.

Fling, fail, and laugh your way upward in a rope-tied co-op climb where one mistake resets the entire team. Coordinate color-locked interactions, manage momentum and tension, and survive traps and hazards together.
